## Summary

Describe the user-visible or scientific change.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .`
- [ ] `python -m ruff format --check .`
- [ ] Relevant pytest commands pass
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when needed
- [ ] No datasets, embeddings, caches, secrets, or generated builds are included

## Scientific impact

State whether this changes graph construction, partitioning, representation, defaults,
or paper-result comparisons. Include before/after evidence for scientific changes.
